_comment: Changes to recipes the game already has. Row names are recipe IDs (see data/DataTables/DT_EnemyCrafting.json from alchemists-tools extract).

WoodGear._comment: Processor: 1 Large Wooden Gear -> 4 Small Wooden Gears (was 3). Only the field given changes: the ingredient, time and craft type stay.

WhisperingFields._comment: Brew Barrel: 20 Linseed Oil + 80 Fruit Wine (was 40 + 80). A list is replaced whole, so both ingredients are given.
